Battle your way through a fully custom **Gym & Badge progression system** — earn your badges, unlock higher level caps, and prove you're the best trainer around. Most of what you'll interact with as a player has been **crafted specifically for this server**, so you won't find this experience anywhere else.

Oh, and did we mention? **Zero pay-to-win.** Your skill is the only thing that matters here.

Explore breathtaking terrain across a revamped Overworld, Nether, and End — then hop on voice chat and share the moment with your friends.

🏆 Badge-Based Level Cap Progression
🌍 Stunning World Generation
🎙️ Proximity Voice Chat
🚫 No Pay-to-Win.

*Come for the Pokémon. Stay for the adventure.*

**Join us at `147.135.11.66`**
